alerts.desc: The anti-MIME-sniffing header X-Content-Type-Options was not set to 'nosniff'.
alerts.solution: Ensure the application sets the X-Content-Type-Options header to 'nosniff' for responses.

alerts.alert: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.desc: The application did not return a Content-Security-Policy header.
alerts.solution: Define and return a Content-Security-Policy header that limits trusted sources.
